content.title: City of Arvada Welcomes Allison Scheck as New Deputy City Manager
content.summary: Allison Scheck has been appointed as the new Deputy City Manager for the City of Arvada, effective September 15, 2025. With over 20 years of experience in both public and private sectors, she previously served as Deputy City Manager for Wheat Ridge, where she led various strategic initiatives. Scheck will oversee multiple departments in Arvada, and her extensive background in leadership and community engagement is expected to benefit the city significantly.
content.body:
![Sllison Scheck Headshot](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=6392)

Arvada, CO - The City of Arvada is pleased to welcome Allison (Alli) Scheck as one of the City’s new Deputy City Managers, effective September 15, 2025. Scheck brings more than two decades of experience in both public and private sectors exemplifying a collaborative leadership style, solid creative problem solving skills and the ability to guide organizations through periods of change and challenge.  
  
Scheck most recently served as the Deputy City Manager for the City of Wheat Ridge, where she provided strategic leadership across budget, risk management, human resources, IT, finance, procurement, communications, the City Clerk’s office and City administration. In this role, Scheck led high-profile initiatives in strategic planning, community engagement, diversity and inclusion and operational modernization, earning recognition for building resilient systems, empowering teams and fostering partnerships benefitting both local and regional communities.  
  
Prior to her work at the City of Wheat Ridge, Scheck held leadership positions with the City of Lakewood and Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, where she oversaw major venues, complex budgets and large-scale public engagement efforts.  
  
As one of the Deputy City Managers at the City of Arvada, Scheck will provide strategic leadership across various City work systems and departments including Community and Economic Development, Infrastructure and Vibrant Community and Neighborhoods.  
  
"Alli is a highly respected public servant, and we welcome her to our organization as well as to our community,” said Don Wick, Arvada’s City Manager.  
  
“Alli's depth of professional experience in both the public and private sectors will serve the community and our organization well. Alli brings the kind of knowledge, skills, and experience that will help continue to move our organization and our community into the future," he continued.  
  
Scheck holds a Master of Public Administration from the University of Colorado Denver and a B.A. in Organization Communication from Metropolitan State University of Denver. She serves on multiple boards and committees, including the Colorado City & County Management Association Board, the ICMA Assistant Chief Administrative Officer Committee and the Jeffco Schools Foundation Board of Directors.
